ee:variables.ee:set-variable: %dw 2.0 output application/java var errorNamespace = error.errorType.namespace default '' var errorIdentifier = error.errorType.identifier default '' var isRetryable = ( (errorNamespace == 'DB' and (['CONNECTIVITY', 'RETRY_EXHAUSTED'] contains errorIdentifier)) or errorIdentifier == 'CONNECTIVITY' or errorNamespace == 'CONNECTIVITY' ) --- if (vars.httpStatus != null) vars.httpStatus as Number else if (['UNKNOWN_SKU', 'RESERVATION_NOT_FOUND', 'PAYMENT_NOT_FOUND', 'SHIPPING_NOT_FOUND'] contains errorIdentifier) 404 else if (['INVALID_COMMAND', 'INVALID_ITEM', 'INVALID_ITEMS', 'INVALID_REQUEST', 'INVALID_QUANTITY'] contains errorIdentifier) 400 else if (['INSUFFICIENT_STOCK', 'COMMAND_IN_PROGRESS', 'PAYMENT_DECLINED', 'INVALID_PAYMENT_STATE', 'STOCK_RESTORE_FAILED', 'RESERVATION_UPDATE_FAILED', 'INVALID_RESERVATION_STATE', 'SHIPPING_DECLINED', 'SERVICE_UNAVAILABLE', 'INVALID_SHIPPING_STATE'] contains errorIdentifier) 409 else if (isRetryable) 503 else if (errorIdentifier == 'NOT_FOUND') 404 else if (errorIdentifier == 'BAD_REQUEST') 400 else if (errorIdentifier == 'METHOD_NOT_ALLOWED') 405 else if (errorIdentifier == 'NOT_ACCEPTABLE') 406 else if (errorIdentifier == 'UNSUPPORTED_MEDIA_TYPE') 415 else if (errorIdentifier == 'NOT_IMPLEMENTED') 501 else 500
